{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Returns current percentage of mass from items stored in a vest relative to the maximum capacity of the vest. <br>
It is equivalent to this formula:
<sqf>_loadVest = massOfAllItemsInVest / getContainerMaxLoad vest player;</sqf>

|s1= [[loadVest]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>_weight = loadVest player;</sqf>

|seealso= [[load]] [[loadAbs]] [[loadBackpack]] [[loadUniform]] [[getMass]] [[weightRTD]] [[getContainerMaxLoad]]
